bound: k=2 not_enacted in n=15. Rule of three applies only at k=0 (95% upper bound = 3/n = 20%); for k=2 the exact one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound is BetaInv(0.95; k+1, n-k) = BetaInv(0.95; 3, 13) = 36.3%. Point estimate 13.3% wrong-signed follow attributions; both misses are same-shaped (agent claims 'follow' on an aggressive-speech SP, then passes or speaks conciliatorily).
